supersedes: The original declaration's permission to rank future work from completed Lab families or non-V8 historical Optimization mechanisms.
The original declaration's rule that a Stage-A nonrobust result may close the family and immediately move to another family.
The generic optional Lab-detour rule for the duration of this scoped exact-V8 program.

economic_parent.identity_rule: V8 is its own economic parent. It is not optimized toward V7 behavior, weights, risk contract or historical economic surface.
economic_parent.v7_role: Lineage and identity-separation context only; no V7 result, parameter or ledger may select or tune this Unit.

allowed_selection_inputs: The exact frozen V8 package and its campaign-owned frozen baseline.
The valid clean exact-V8 V2 lifecycle and candidate ledgers with pinned hashes.
Naturally accruing exact-V8 Live research ledgers after they contain complete attributable events.
Prospectively declared outputs created inside V8-OPT-U001-PORTFOLIO-DD.
prohibited_selection_inputs: Historical Lab economic outcomes, candidates, thresholds, fitted parameters or ranking conclusions.
V7 economic results, control surfaces or risk settings as optimization targets.
Non-V8 legacy Optimization winners or failures used as candidate seeds.
External market or research data for this Unit.

allowed: Removal or disablement of an existing V8 strategy/component.
Portfolio reconstruction from the existing V8 component and opportunity universe.
Admission, collision, ordering, priority, sizing, risk, hold, protection and exit changes.
Suppression, reordering or resizing of opportunities exact V8 already emits.
optimization_implementation_scope.new_entry_strategy_definition: Any new symbol, timeframe, signal family, direction or opportunity timestamp not emitted by exact V8, including loosening or rewriting entry conditions to manufacture additional opportunities.
optimization_implementation_scope.out_of_scope_clue_rule: A diagnostic that implies novel entry alpha may be recorded as out-of-scope only; it cannot interrupt or expand the active Optimization Unit.

lab_boundary.resume_condition: Only a later explicit user direction or a separately authorized post-optimization promotion workflow may change this boundary.

unit.name: Exact-V8 portfolio risk composition and drawdown rehabilitation
unit.mechanism_boundary: V8 component effective risk, aggregate admission and causal closed-balance drawdown response on the unchanged V8 opportunity universe. Parameter, code and mechanism changes are allowed; new opportunity generation is not.
unit.closure_rule: No single grid, threshold, candidate or proxy nonconfirmation can close the Unit. Stages A through D must finish serially under their frozen rules. The Unit closes only when all proxy layers have no robust survivor, or after its sole unchanged MT5 finalist validly nonconfirms and no predeclared proxy layer remains.
unit.next_unit_rule: Only after durable Unit-001 closure may a newly named V8-native Unit be selected from diagnostics generated by V8 or this Unit. Historical Lab queues do not determine the successor.

ordered_deep_stages.purpose: Map the V8-only monotone weight, base-position-risk and aggregate-cap surface and identify robust or nearest basins.

seed_precedence: Stage-A robust centers in declared rank order.
If fewer than three, fill with Stage-A eligible points ranked by stressed-net-to-drawdown efficiency, stressed net, lower drawdown and distance from V8.

If no eligible point exists, use up to three separated near-miss points minimizing normalized stressed-retention deficit plus normalized drawdown excess, then maximizing stressed-net-to-drawdown efficiency.
ordered_deep_stages.bounds: Clip to Stage-A parameter bounds, retain Passive zero and exact-V8 monotone effective-risk ceilings, then deduplicate exact parameter vectors before replay.
ordered_deep_stages.robustness: Use immediate half-step neighbors with the same minimum four eligible neighbors across three axes; isolated maxima do not survive.

ordered_deep_stages.state_variable: Prior realized closed-balance drawdown from its causal high-water mark; no future mark, open-equity oracle or period label.
ordered_deep_stages.execution_rule: The state multiplier affects only future executable birth volume after the trigger. It never force-closes an existing position and never creates an unobserved lifecycle.

ordered_deep_stages.cost_book: Use both actual and the already recorded doubled-observed-cost stressed net; no new cost fit.
ordered_deep_stages.survival: Actual and stressed net plus minimum balance must be positive in every opened fresh block; block raw closed-balance drawdown must not exceed 30%, whole-path stressed retention must be at least 75% of V8 and whole-path drawdown must improve by at least five points.
ordered_deep_stages.ranking: Maximize the weakest fresh-block stressed net, then whole-path stressed-net-to-drawdown efficiency, stressed net and lower drawdown. Locked holdout never substitutes an alternate.

ordered_deep_stages.conditional: Only one unchanged Stage-D survivor may enter.
ordered_deep_stages.authority: Native result can close or support the Optimization Unit but has no direct Live authority.
